runtimes.name: Python (Wasm)
runtimes.description: Python as a WebAssembly component (componentize-py, Spin Python SDK) — class HttpHandler(http.Handler) with async handle_request(request). Pure-Python dependencies from requirements.txt; needs WebAssembly support in the region.

files.{file}:
from urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlsplit

from spin_sdk import http
from spin_sdk.http import Request, Response


class HttpHandler(http.Handler):
    """Every trigger reaches the component as an HTTP request: queue messages and schedule
    ticks arrive as CloudEvents (the ce-type header names the event)."""

    async def handle_request(self, request: Request) -> Response:
        event = request.headers.get("ce-type", "")
        if event == "dev.runr.schedule.tick":
            body = "tick from Python (Wasm)"
        elif event == "dev.runr.queue.message":
            body = f"processed {(request.body or b'').decode()} (from Python, Wasm)"
        else:
            name = parse_qs(urlsplit(request.uri).query).get("name", ["World"])[0]
            body = f"Hello, {name}! (from Python, Wasm)"
        print(body)
        return Response(200, {"content-type": "text/plain"}, bytes(body, "utf-8"))

spin_manifest_version = 2

runtimes.name: Rust (Wasm)
runtimes.description: Rust compiled to a WebAssembly component with the Spin SDK — #[http_component] fn handle(req: Request). Millisecond-class cold starts in the WebAssembly sandbox; needs WebAssembly support in the region.

build.command: { [ -f Cargo.lock ] || cp /opt/runr/rust/Cargo.lock . ; } && ln -sfn "$CARGO_TARGET_DIR" target && spin build

files.Cargo.toml:
# Default Cargo.toml of a wasm-rust function (build.files): the handler file is the crate root.
# A FaaS project may bring its own Cargo.toml (more crates); keep crate-type cdylib and the
# package name, or change the component source in spin.toml with it.
[package]
name = "runr-function"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.78"
publish = false

[lib]
crate-type = ["cdylib"]
path = "lib.rs"

[dependencies]
anyhow = "1"
spin-sdk = "5.2.0"

[workspace]

[application]
